description: This file manages Slack authorization logic, including caching allowlists, resolving user and channel info, and authorizing system events based on allowlists and policies.

methods.name: getPairingAllowFromCacheTtlMs
methods.description: Retrieves the TTL for pairing allow-from cache, configurable via environment variable or defaults to 5000ms.

methods.name: getAllowFromCacheState
methods.description: Gets or initializes the cache state for a given SlackMonitorContext.

methods.name: buildBaseAllowFrom
methods.description: Builds the base allow list from the context's allowFrom property.

methods.name: resolveSlackEffectiveAllowFrom
methods.description: Resolves the effective allow list for Slack, including caching and optional pairing store inclusion.

methods.name: clearSlackAllowFromCacheForTest
methods.description: Clears the allow-from cache, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: isSlackSenderAllowListed
methods.description: Checks if a sender is allowlisted based on the provided allow list and optional name matching.

methods.name: authorizeSlackSystemEventSender
methods.description: Authorizes a Slack system event sender based on sender ID, channel info, allowlists, and policies.
